newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia foils drug smuggling attempt - paper.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia foils drug smuggling attempt - paper.

text.p: Saudi border guards have foiled an attempt to smuggle 255 kg (561 lb) of drugs into the country, a Saudi newspaper said on Thursday.
Okaz daily said the attempt was uncovered after border guards found a telephone bill inside a car in which the drugs were concealed. It gave no further details.
Saudi law provides for the death penalty by beheading against capital crimes, including drug smuggling.
